directions.prototype_dirs: 0..7 (0 = towards the camera, 2 = left, 4 = away, 6 = right); BACK = {3,4,5}
directions.flip: draw mirrored (scale x = -1 around the pivot) when dirSide(dir, facing) < 0
directions.rule: scale.md §4.1 / GDD §12.1.2: 2 drawn directions (SE, NE) + horizontal mirror (SW, NW); the 8 logical directions of the engine map onto these 4 views

mirror_rule: flip horizontally around the frame centre line x = 32.0; pivot stays (32, 56)

events.note: slow shamble (speed 2.5 tiles/s): 8 frames @10, 2 steps per cycle; raise fps with speed for elites (Прыткий +30% -> 13 fps)

events.sync: attackTime 1.8 s, hitAt 0.6 s (monsters.json): 6 frames at 5 fps, frame 3 (the smash) starts at exactly 0.6 s; the anim ends at 1.2 s, hold idle for the rest of attackTime. Heavy two-handed overhead blow (GDD: «редкий тяжёлый удар»), dirt kicked up at the claws on frames 3-4

events.note: 2 frames, head snaps back; play over idle/walk
recoils, buckles, falls on its face; the Небыль leaves the body as a small green wisp (4-6); last frame holds (corpse, the engine fades it out)

events.frames: 0 a clawed hand breaks the ground, 1 head and both hands, 2 head and shoulders, 3 waist-deep, 4 climbs out on one knee, 5 stands shaking the earth off (≈ idle 0)
events.sync: riseTime 0.8 s (zones ambush.rise, Кривша summon): frame = min(5, floor(t / riseTime * 6)); the grave (hole, soil, torn turf) is part of the frames, so DRAW IT AT THE PIVOT WITHOUT the grey-box clip/slide (world.js 'rise'). Summoned by Кривша: fx_krivsha_summon frames 0-2 come first (upyr_visible_from_frame 3): play rise over the remaining 0.5 s -> frame = min(5, floor((t - 0.3) / 0.5 * 6)), nothing before t = 0.3
